## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement you'd like to see.

## Motivation & Problem
What problem does this feature solve? Why is it useful to developers using Antigravity CLI?

## Proposed Implementation / Design
Describe how you envision this feature working (e.g. new hook event, statusline segment, skill workflow, CLI helper).

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any mockups, screenshots, or examples here.
